title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics - runbook & alert context enrichment
author: Priya Rao
description: Motivation: on-call runs and automated diagnostics often lack enough contextual links (runbooks, relevant SLOs, recent incident history) to make triage fast. This PR adds a lightweight context enrichment pipeline that attaches runbook anchors, SLO links, and recent related incidents to alerts before they are posted to on-call channels. The feature is opt-in and controlled by config flags and RBAC so customers using Private or Dedicated deployments can disable enrichment. Summary of changes: - new context_enricher service that prefetches runbook sections and SLO metadata - mapping layer that links alert signatures to canonical runbooks (heuristics + tag mapping) - caching layer with TTL and LRU eviction to avoid runtime amplification - small telemetry additions: context.attach_duration_ms, runbook_hit, runbook_miss - CLI and config: --enrichment-enabled, enrichment.ttl, enrichment.max_prefetch - docs: updated oncall runbook docs and troubleshooting guide - tests: unit tests for mapping heuristics and integration test for enrichment end-to-end Checklist: - [x] design doc (ENG-3421) attached - [x] unit/integration tests added - [x] docs updated - [x] feature gated behind config and feature flag - [x] security review (no new secrets persisted) Rollout plan: feature off by default; enable for internal SRE first for 2 weeks; monitor runbook_hit and attach_duration_ms and error rates. If attach_duration_ms increases overall alert latency beyond threshold, the service falls back to async enrichment (post-alert update).
